title: fix(pm): dispatch-gates derives fifteen whole-root lint gates from the diffs that can move them
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XVVos8qr5X7YcVK57du1fmt)_

Fixes #31257

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`dispatch-gates --commands` 新增 15 条「按门禁自己的扫描范围 + 自己的第一道过滤」判定的派生行。改到某道全仓 lint 门禁真正会读、且能通过它自身预过滤的文件时(例如含 `getService` 的插件源码、含 `.json(` 的路由文件、新的 `sql-driver-*.ts` 分片),就把那道门禁派给卡。另有 2 道(`check:stack-collection-maps`、`check:filter-alias-parity`)经实测只读自己源码里写死的文件,路径派生早已覆盖,无需新行。
- 为什么改:这 18 道门禁在 CI 里每个 PR 都跑,但本地派生清单在改动不在它们「主包」时从不列出它们,开发者报「派生门禁全绿」后 CI 才红(#31214 就踩过一次)。
- 风险与回滚:只动 `scripts/pm/` 下的派生工具与自测,不改任何门禁检查什么,不动 workflow;最坏情况是多派生一道几秒的门禁,或漏派生(即现状)。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` 的 `POPULATION_NETS` 与 `reachesPopulationNet`;`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.data.mjs` 新增的 15 条 `CHANGE_KIND_ROWS`。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack packages/services/service-settings/src/settings-service-plugin.ts packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-crud.ts`,预期多出 `pnpm check:init-service-contract`、`check:settings-bind-window`、`check:startup-registry-verdict` 等(main 上没有)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Eighteen lint steps run on every PR (`lint.yml`, no `paths:` filter) over a whole-root population, and `--commands` never handed them to a card whose diff sat outside their home package: eleven print in the declared-WIDE block and seven in the artifact-roster block, and the seat ruling on #30763 keeps both blocks out of `--commands` wholesale. This PR closes them family by family.

**Fifteen get a change-kind row (option a)**, each bound to its own **population net**: the gate's own walk (roots, kept file names, skipped names and directories, read off its source) plus the gate's own first filter, the cheap pre-filter most of them run before their AST pass. Two gates expose their per-file reader and keep no ledger, so the net **imports** it instead of copying it (`check:runner-env-posture`: `isProductSource` + `findRunnerEnvReads`; `check:error-code-casing`: `findViolations`); both modules are dependency-free, so the tool still runs with no install. A deleted population file is judged on the content it HAD (HEAD's blob, else the blob before the deleting commit), so a move or delete that strands a ledger row or a provider still counts, while a path git never held does not.

| Gate | Block | Net (population · filter) | Hits / population at 07559ce5 | Recall vs the gate's own pass | Local wall |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `check:init-service-contract` | WIDE | packages non-test `.ts` · `PREFILTER_TOKENS` (getService ×3, providesServices) | 217 / 4498 | `--list` 31 files, 0 missed | 2.5 s |
| `check:settings-bind-window` | WIDE | same · + `trigger` | 657 / 4498 | `--list` 11, 0 missed | 4.2 s |
| `check:startup-registry-verdict` | WIDE | same · registry probes, open registries, providesServices | 222 / 4498 | `--list` 29, 0 missed | 3.7 s |
| `check:optional-error-sink` | WIDE | packages non-test `.ts` · `CHANNEL_PREFILTER` | 1070 / 4498 | `--list` 204, 0 missed | 5.3 s |
| `check:resume-authority-declared` | WIDE | packages + examples · `defineActionDescriptor` | 19 / 4691 | `--list` 16, 0 missed | 1.1 s |
| `check:route-envelope` | WIDE | packages non-test `.ts` · `-routes.ts` / off-convention / domains by path, `.json(` by content | 160 / 4498 | MODULES 56 files, 0 missed | 3.8 s |
| `check:verify-stand-in` | WIDE | packages + examples (tests included) · guarded names read from `eslint.config.mjs`, verify src by path | 83 / 12003 | the census pre-filter itself | 2.0 s |
| `check:wildcard-fallthrough` | WIDE | packages non-test `.ts` · a quoted `/*` | 143 / 4498 | `--list` 7, 0 missed | 2.0 s |
| `check:live-db-isolation` | WIDE | packages, apps, examples (tests included) · `OS_TEST_{MYSQL,POSTGRES}_URL` | 101 / 12010 | 65 live suites, 0 missed | 5.9 s |
| `check:runner-env-posture` | WIDE | the gate's `isProductSource` · its `findRunnerEnvReads` (imported) | 0 / 4357 | the gate's own reader | 8.7 s |
| `check:meta-type-normalized` | WIDE | `packages/rest/src` non-test, path only | 56 / 56 | the gate's own 56 files | 0.8 s |
| `check:tenant-chokepoint` | roster | `sql-driver-*.ts` listed in the driver-sql src dir, path only | 36 / 36 | the gate's listing (39 = 3 drivers + 36) | 1.0 s |
| `check:authz-resolver` | roster | packages non-test TS · both grant tables named | 62 / 4489 | its `queriesAllGrantTables` needs both | 2.3 s |
| `check:error-code-casing` | roster | packages `.ts/.tsx` · its `findViolations` (imported) | 4 / 11748 | the gate's own reader (4 exempt) | 12.6 s |
| `check:object-def-param-keys` | roster | tracked `.ts` under a package `src` · a class or an `as any` | 1248 / 4236 | `--list` 244, 0 missed | 7.0 s |

**Two are closed by measurement (option c):** `check:stack-collection-maps` and `check:filter-alias-parity` read only files their own source spells as literals (8 and 3), walk no root, and the path derivation already matches the gate for every one of those files. The census's "whole-root walk" signature for `filter-alias-parity` was its AST `walk` generator.

**One is not closed here:** `check:published-readme-exports` (see Acceptance notes).

## Why

#31214 paid a CI round trip on `check:error-code-provenance`, a family of the same class; PR #31254 fixed three and #31257 holds the rest. A dev report could read "all derived gates green" while CI went red on any of these.

## Tests

New cases in `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs`, table-driven over the fifteen nets (`NET_CASES`, one entry per net, held to `POPULATION_NETS` key for key):

- **Per net:** a real diff shape is a hit (a plugin init lookup, a settings `trigger`, a `hasService` probe, an optional-`error` sink type, a pausing descriptor, a `c.json(` writer, a stand-in call in a verify test, a wildcard mount, a live suite's URL read, a runner-variable branch, a new REST source, the next `sql-driver-*` split, both grant tables, a lowercase code, a class extending the SQL driver); the gate's own walk exclusion is a miss; a population file without the filter is a miss; a deleted file is judged on its prior content (hit and miss); a path git never held is a miss; a path outside the roots is a miss; the copied spellings are still in the gate's source (and for startup/sink the token SET equals the gate's own Map/Set); exactly one row names the gate, bound to this net; a live specimen derives the gate through the whole table; the rendered lead says it needs no build and why no card had it.
- **Imported readers** are identical to the gates' own functions; the verify net reads the guarded names off the ESLint config and throws on a config without the table; a docs-only page derives none of the fifteen.
- **Closures:** for both roster gates, every source file the gate reads is a literal the path derivation already matches (8/8, 3/3), and the gate walks no root.
- **Slow tier:** each net discriminates on the live tree, and every file each gate's own `--list` names is inside its net (7 gates, 0 missed).
- **Pins moved:** the inherited-population census row 744 → 748 (four import lines above it); two whole-table section-count pins (i18n bundle, metadata form) now read through the entries naming `check:i18n`, because the optional-sink and object-def nets fire on the same live files for their own reason.

**Ablation** (one fast-tier run, three mutations through nested `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restore proven twice: blob == HEAD `c0eee2c17012`, `git diff HEAD` empty), 47 of 2174 cases red, every one named:

- walk exclusion removed from `inNetPopulation` ⇒ red "…the gate's walk excludes X, so the net does too" for the 11 nets that exclude by file name.
- token filter replaced by `true` in `reachesPopulationNet` ⇒ red "a population file without the gate's filter is not a hit" for the 9 token nets (the pattern and imported-reader nets are unaffected by that line, as designed).
- prior-content read replaced by "any absent path counts" ⇒ red "a deleted file is judged on the content it had" and "a path git never held is not a hit" for all 13 content nets.
- also red: the existing "a test path emits the convention section" count pin (the widened walk lets nets fire on test files).

## Acceptance notes

- **`check:published-readme-exports`: not derived; for a follow-up card.** Its population is the 129 published markdown docs of public packages outside `ui/`, plus the BUILT type entries of the 77 targets (68 packages) their 268 import statements reach. A path net over those packages is close to every package's source, so a precise net needs a member-name reader (the names each doc imports, matched against declarations in the reached package). The gate also needs those packages built (exit 3 on an unbuilt worktree). Left out rather than shipped imprecise.
- **What a net cannot see:** a gate that follows an import out of the judged file (settings-bind-window resolves a hook name through one) can be moved by the imported file alone; and a new token in a gate's pre-filter widens the gate before the net, until the self-test's spelling pin reds on it.
- **Precision trade:** `optional-error-sink` (24% of its population) and `object-def-param-keys` (30%) are as wide as the gates' own first filters; both are about 5–7 s and unconditional in CI.
- No `.github/**` edit; no change to what any gate checks.

## Verification

Gate union from `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on this diff: 30 families, run on head `81c8a785` (after merging `origin/main`), reconciled with `--ran`: "30 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 30 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 30 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)".

</details>

- Full battery (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --self-test`): on head `81c8a785`, "✓ dispatch-gates self-test: 2483 cases pass." (fast 2174 cases in 422.9 s, slow 309 cases in 1282.6 s).
- `npx eslint --no-inline-config` on the three files: exit 0. `node scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs`: exit 0. No package touched, so no package `lint`/`test`/`typecheck` is owed.
- CI families are read from this PR's check-runs, not re-run here.
